_meta.about: Ikirundi — igipimo ca mbere c'ubuhinduzi, cakozwe n'ubwenge bw'ikoranabuhanga (AI). Imiterere n'ibimenyetso (id) nk'ibiri muri content/site.fr.json (ururimi rw'intango). Urufunguzo rwose rutabonetse rusubira ku nyandiko y'igifaransa. Agaciro kanditswe « BIZUZUZWA (À COMPLÉTER) » ntikamenyekana, kandi kategekanywa gutangwa na Crispy Food Products. Urutonde (array) rusimbuza burundu urw'igifaransa : rugumane uburebure, urutonde n'amakuru (id, model, price, image, indent) nk'ayo mu gifaransa — `npm run content:check` irabigenzura. Inomero za terefone, imiyoboro ya media na inomero ya WhatsApp ntizisubiwemo hano ku bushake : zikomeza kuva mu dosiye y'igifaransa.
_meta.important: Ibisobanuro vyose biri muri iyi dosiye bikwiye kwongera gusuzumwa n'umuntu afise Ikirundi nk'ururimi rw'amavuko, imbere yo kubikwirikizwa burundu.

mushroom.title: Ubutunzi bw'amashamba y'i Burundi
mushroom.intro: Ibisukuti birahari hose kw'isi. Ibisukuti bikozwe mu bihumyo ni bikeyi cane. Krumbz irashimika ikintu co ng'aha iwacu : amashamba n'imisozi y'i Burundi birimwo uduce dutandukanye tw'ibihumyo biribwa, bitoragurwa kuva kera bikaguzwa ku masoko, gushika i Bujumbura.

items.title: Vitamine zo mu mugwi B
items.text: Riboflavine, niacine na acide pantothénique birafasha guhindura ibifungurwa kuba ingufu.

items.title: Potasiyumu
items.text: Isasu rifasha imikorere myiza y'imitsi no kugumya umuvuduko w'amaraso usanzwe.

items.title: Seleniyumu
items.text: Birafasha kurinda uduce tw'umubiri ku ngaruka z'ubusasagaze.

items.title: Ergothioneine
items.text: Ikintu kiramutsa kamere gikingira, aho igihumyo kiri mu bibitanga vyiza kuruta mu bifungurwa.

items.title: Proteine na fibre
items.text: Igihumyo gitanga proteine na fibre, hamwe n'amavuta make cane.

items.title: Vitamine D ivuye ku zuba
items.text: Igihumyo kigeretswe ku zuba, gitegura vitamine D, nk'uko urukoba rwacu rubigenza.

mushroom.disclaimer: Aya makuru arasigura igihumyo nk'ikifungurwa. Ntavuga ivyo ibisukuti vya Krumbz birimwo, ivyo bikaba biboneka ku rupapuro rw'Ibicuruzwa.

chapters.title: Bikorewe mu Burundi
chapters.text: Krumbz irakorerwa i Bujumbura, mu Quartier Industriel, na Crispy Food Products. Amateka y'ikigo n'italiki yo gushingwa : BIZUZUZWA (À COMPLÉTER).

chapters.title: Inkomoko y'igihumyo
chapters.text: Igihumyo ni co kigize umusingi wa Krumbz. Ikifungurwa c'umuco cahora mu mashamba y'i Burundi, gitanga vitamine zo mu mugwi B, amasasu nka potasiyumu na seleniyumu, n'ibintu biramutsa bikingira. Twagikoze umutima w'igisukuti kidasanzwe.

sections.title: Uwasohoye urubuga
body: Niyondiko Joffre (« Jubu Niyoko »), umudandaza wemejwe w'ikirango ca Krumbz (Crispy Food Products) i Gitega, mu Burundi. Uru rubuga rwasohowe n'umudandaza, si n'uwakoze ibicuruzwa.
Uburenganzira bw'amategeko : umuntu ku giti ciwe (ntacisi c'ikigo canditse).
Aho aba : Gitega, Bwoga 2, n° 37, Uburundi.
Inomero y'ikimenyetso c'ikori (NIF) : ntikoreshwa (umuntu ku giti ciwe).
Icyandikiro c'ubudandaji : ntikoreshwa (umuntu ku giti ciwe).

sections.title: Aho urubuga rubikwa (hosting)
body: Hostinger International Ltd., 61 Lordou Vironos Street, 6023 Larnaca, Kiripo — hostinger.com.

sections.title: Uburenganzira bw'ubuhanga
body: Urubuga (inyandiko, imitunganirizo, amashusho n'itegeko) ni ibintu vya Niyondiko Joffre, umudandaza wemejwe wa Krumbz.
Ikirango ca Krumbz, ibimenyetso vyaco n'imifungasho ni ibintu vya Crispy Food Products, gitanga uburenganzira umudandaza wako kubikoresha.
Gusubiramwo ibintu ata ruhusa ni ivyabujijwe.

sections.title: Amakuru bwite
body: Agatebo kabikwa gusa mu mushakishi wawe (ubwo bubiko ni ubwiwe) kandi ntikarungikwa kuri seriveri iyariyo yose.
Amakuru yashizwe mu rupapuro rw'igitumizo (izina, terefone, igisagara, umutaa) akoreshwa gusa mu gutegura ubutumwa bwa WhatsApp uhitamwo kurungika. Ntabikwa n'urubuga.
Uru rubuga ntirukoresha udukoresho twa reklame canke abakurikirana abandi.
Ku kindi kibazo ku vyerekeye amakuru yawe : niyondikojoffreasjubu@gmail.com.

sections.title: Inkomezi
body: Amafoto ni ay'akarorero gusa. Ibiciro, imiterere n'ukuboneka biremezwa igihe utumije kuri WhatsApp.
